'''2012 Bespin Regionals Matt Hanson LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Hanson]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
